products.name: Frase
products.note: SEO content AI; SERP analysis; competitive data scraping; search algorithm dependency

reading.body:
Frase operates in the narrow gap between search engine optimization and AI-generated content, selling directly to teams that need both to rank on Google and to appear in AI model outputs simultaneously.

The company's core offering reflects a real constraint in content strategy. As search traffic fragments across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini, a team that optimizes only for one destination now loses ground on others. Frase's tracking of daily rankings and citation share across all five platforms addresses this fragmentation. The product bundles SEO analysis, content drafting, and cross-platform monitoring into one workflow, which reduces tool switching but also signals that no single search or AI platform yet dominates enough to make the others optional.

This dependency on multiple search and generative systems creates leverage for Frase but no durable moat. The company's value decays if Google or any major LLM provider changes how it ranks or cites sources, or if content teams decide to optimize for only one channel. The pricing tier structure, starting at $39 per month, targets smaller content teams and agencies rather than enterprises, which suggests the market for this integration is still forming and price-sensitive.

The data does not cover Frase's compute costs, infrastructure footprint, or whether its daily crawl and ranking checks create meaningful demand on grid or data center resources. It also does not reveal whether the company is gaining or losing share as AI-generated content becomes more common, or whether search platforms are restricting the competitive data scraping that makes its SERP analysis possible.

profile_text.body:
# Frase

Frase describes itself as a content operating system for AI search that researches, writes, optimizes, publishes, and monitors content to rank on Google and get cited by AI. The platform runs what the company calls "the whole content loop" in one place, combining SEO, GEO, and AEO capabilities. It checks each page on a site for search ranking potential and AI-readiness, scores them, and writes recommended fixes. Frase publishes into existing content management systems including WordPress, Webflow, Sanity, and Wix, or alternatively into FraseCMS, which the company describes as an agent-ready CMS that can be hosted or run headless on a user's own domain.

The platform tracks AI visibility daily across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI to show where a site's pages appear in AI answers and alerts users when share of voice changes. Frase offers multilingual support across 70+ languages and integrates with AI tools via MCP server, CLI, and API. It also supports varying levels of autonomy, allowing users to configure whether Frase publishes content independently, keeps every page under review, or operates somewhere in between. Pricing starts at $39 per month billed yearly for one site and one person, with a Professional tier at $103 per month that adds seats, sites, and monthly content volume.
